text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun. Today is the day we put 
our new formula for victory into practice.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Though it remains incomplete, I intend to 
perfect this equation and claim victory 
against any opponent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even if the probability of victory gained 
from it is less than one percent.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Right, I'll be on my way then.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho! Biwa 
Hayahide makes her appearance in the 
paddock as—

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Is that Biwa Hayahide? Her 
hindquarters are remarkably 
well-developed. Just what kind of special 
training has she been...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, it's special training necessary 
for victory.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because a formula for victory is literally 
a "formula to win"...!
